text:
alertbot: INCIDENT ALERT — Canary cluster new-route-prod-3 reporting 5xx spike (error rate 18%) and tail latency > 2s for streaming requests. Threshold crossed at 02:34 UTC. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

taylor-eng: seeing a bunch of `runtime error: kv cache mismatch` in canary logs, happening right after the new deployment rolled traffic. Repro on prod-canary-3 with seq len 1024.

maria-oncall: I'm on it — taking page. switching routing to stable-route for canary slice 3 to stop customer traffic. initiating immediate safety cut.

devops-bot: Executing action: /feature-flag-toggle --flag new_route_routing --env prod --action OFF --actor maria-oncall

taylor-eng: confirmed flag toggle request, waiting for LB drain (30s). logs still spiking but new requests to that canary should stop.

sam-cs: ping — any estimate on customer impact? Support ticket #4721 just flagged timeouts from an integration partner.

maria-oncall: initial triage: approx 2.1k requests in last 10m, ~120 requests failed for a small subset of long-stream sessions. CS: likely degraded streaming for a handful of enterprise customers. Can send customer notify draft after further confirmation.

alex-platform: quick note — canary image pulled GPU runtime with updated attention kernel, looks like kernel selection mismatch on some hosts. Suspect incompatible kernel+quantized weights causing internal panics.

taylor-eng: reproducer: run prompt with prefix length ~900 on canary host `prod-canary-3-7` and you'll hit OOM-ish stack: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-quant-v2","input":"<long session>"}'
# tail -f /var/log/inference/worker.log | grep kv_cache
```

maria-oncall: traffic away, error rate down to 0.8% in 60s. Keeping in mitigation state. Will coordinate rollback of canary image and rollback feature flag to keep stable route.

devops-bot: ACTION LOG — feature flag `new_route_routing` set OFF by maria-oncall at 02:36 UTC. LB routing reverted for canary slice 3.

sam-cs: thanks. I'll open notification: "We're investigating brief streaming degradation affecting a small number of customers; we've routed traffic to the stable endpoint and are rolling back the canary. ETA 30–45m for full validation." Want me to send now?

maria-oncall: send the draft now to affected customers list. include workaround: use stable endpoint `stable.redwood.ai` and advise retrying streaming sessions.

alex-platform: starting rollback: deploying previous image tag `v1.7.8` to canary pool and running validation job. rolling one host at a time.

taylor-eng: validation checks: health checks, KV cache warmup, sample long-session runs. If green across 3 hosts, we'll promote to canary and re-enable routing in controlled fashion.

devops-bot: Deploy rollback started at 02:41 UTC. Progress: 1/4 hosts rolled, 2/4 checks passed.

maria-oncall: monitoring telemetry: token-level latency and 5xx trending down. Will keep channel updated. Paging SRE for postmortem tomorrow if we need to dig deeper.

sam-cs: customers notified. Responses: two have acknowledged and will retry in 10m window.

alex-platform: rollback complete 02:48 UTC. All canary hosts running v1.7.8, validation job passed end-to-end tests.

taylor-eng: rerun sample load, no kv cache errors. tail latencies back to baseline.

maria-oncall: preparing to re-enable flag in a more conservative rollout (10% -> 25% -> 50%) once we validate kernel-selection guard in runtime. Not re-enabling until patch lands.

devops-bot: ACTION LOG — rollback complete, canary state stabilized. Incident severity lowered to SEV3 at 02:49 UTC.

sam-cs: closing customer notifications loop. Will follow up with impacted accounts with incident summary after postmortem.

maria-oncall: postmortem owners: alex-platform (root cause & kernel selection), taylor-eng (reproducer & tests), sam-cs (customer comms). Draft initial timeline and RCA notes by EOD today.

taylor-eng: small follow-up: adding a runtime guard to reject kernel combinations with quantized weights; will open PR and request review. :memo:

maria-oncall: thanks team — great coordination. marking incident thread resolved from paging perspective, keeping channel open for postmortem docs.

alertbot: INCIDENT UPDATE — mitigation confirmed, no ongoing customer impact. Closed at 02:52 UTC.
